summary:
Implementation plan updated with resolution of the 403 Forbidden error and menu URL normalization:
1. Identified and resolved reverse proxy and static directory listing collision causing 403 Forbidden.
2. Enabled Express 'trust proxy' to handle Cloud Run and Nginx SSL termination properly.
3. Configured '{ index: false }' on all static express directories (/work, /legal, /demos, /assets, /x7q2m9r4v8k1p6z3).
4. Provided explicit route handlers for all pages with and without trailing slash, all 7 case studies, and branded 404 page.
5. Injected synchronous clean URL head script and updated client-side link interception in js/site.js.
6. Verified all endpoints via curl and successfully recompiled.
